halfLife.notes: Half-life is highly variable and dose-dependent due to non-linear PK (saturable CYP2D6 auto-inhibition). PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

cypInteractions.switchingRelevance: Potent CYP2D6 inhibition raises levels of co-prescribed CYP2D6 substrates. Auto-inhibits its own metabolism, complicating dose titration and washout. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

discontinuationSyndromeRisk.notes: Highest discontinuation risk among the 8 drugs in v0.1. Symptoms can begin within 24-48 hours of a missed dose. Slow taper essential. Anticholinergic rebound is also notable. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

formulationNotes: Tablets available. Controlled-release form not consistently stocked in Malaysia. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.
